blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A former spokesperson of the Supreme Court (SC) on Friday called for a clear documentation system on the process of issuing and correcting death certificates as an independent body looking into drug war killings flag at least five physicians who declared questionable deaths. In a press conference on Friday with the Truth Commission, human rights lawyer and law professor Theodore Te said that the issue needs to be addressed on a systemic level and government bodies like the Justice Sector Coordinating Council (JSCC) should introduce reforms.
